recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the work group later decides to reopen the broader Practitioner-specific contact-purpose question that Jira comments moved to PractitionerRole.
issue_request: FHIR-14415 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested purpose-specific contact details first described for HealthcareService and Practitioner, then narrowed in Jira comments to HealthcareService.contact and PractitionerRole.contact, with the final resolution also naming OrganizationAffiliation.
initial_application: Commit 6c6927cc55 added HealthcareService.contact and PractitionerRole.contact as ExtendedContactDetail and deprecated their old telecom elements. Commit e1320848bd removed the deprecated HealthcareService.telecom and PractitionerRole.telecom elements and converted OrganizationAffiliation.telecom to OrganizationAffiliation.contact as ExtendedContactDetail. Merge commits 522404cd22 and 2f70a91b0d tied the work to the R5 PA ExtendedContactDetail/contact-details change family.
additional_context: FHIR-29035 created ExtendedContactDetail with purpose, name, telecom, address, organization, and period. Brian Postlethwaite's 2022 FHIR-14415 Jira comment explicitly says the issue was applied using ExtendedContactDetail across provider-directory resources. PA 2022-02-16 minutes mention FHIR-14415 re-review during R5 contact-info work, and no Zulip or Confluence evidence found in this investigation conflicted with the current source state.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/fhir.ini actively includes HealthcareService, PractitionerRole, and OrganizationAffiliation; their current structuredefinitions define contact 0..* ExtendedContactDetail; ExtendedContactDetail carries the requested purpose, name, telecom, and address fields; and the old top-level telecom elements for those three resources are absent.
